description: §40.8 (amended S478, code S479) — two `<page>`s in one `<program>`: the second is E-PAGE-DUPLICATE (a route has one page; a second page is a second route file).
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S478 "⭐ RULED — open owner questions, PA recs adopted wholesale" item 60 · ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S479 "⭐ RULED — S478 hand-off §3.A and §3.B, PA recs adopted" item 4
rationale: §40.8: "Two `<page>`s in one `<program>` are an error … The second `<page>` (and each later one) SHALL be **`E-PAGE-DUPLICATE`** (Error), reported at its opener."
